energy_zero: Eprobe,o-Eprobe,v-Ehost,o+Ehost,v, frozen relaxed background; target-only neutral removal.

path.scope: Best sampled head-on ray by background-nucleus clearance; vacancy-side hemisphere when target is displaced, all directions at the vacancy centre. Not a global angular optimum.

vacancy.scope: Geometric occupancy of this relaxed fixed-inventory local basin, not a saturation capacity.

scope: Current-cell static point-regularized BO; representative C h/cell controls still required. No U0/rate/dynamic observable.
